review.explanation: The mention 張華 in the main text refers to the historical figure 張華. The main text says '有人向張華說此事' where 張華 is the person being asked about the anecdote involving 王朗 and 華歆. The annotation sfh1-ev-01-dexing-012-liu-annotation-006 explicitly identifies 張華 as '張華字茂先范陽人也累遷司空', confirming this is the well-known Jin dynasty figure 張華. The candidate evidence from people.json provides the canonical name 張華. The main text context and the annotation both support this identification.

The mention 王隱 appears in annotation sfh1-ev-01-dexing-012-liu-annotation-006 as '王隱晉書曰張華字茂先...'. This is 王隱, the author of the 晉書 (Jin Shu). The candidate evidence from people.json provides the canonical name 王隱. The annotation explicitly attributes the biographical note to 王隱's 晉書, confirming his role as the author. The reference semantics correctly notes that 王隱 is distinct from 張華 (the subject of the annotation).

The mention 司空 refers to the office title held by 張華. The annotation sfh1-ev-01-dexing-012-liu-annotation-006 states '張華字茂先范陽人也累遷司空', explicitly identifying 司空 as the office 張華 attained. The candidate evidence from people.json provides the canonical name 張華. The office title 司空 is used as a metonymic reference to 張華, and the annotation explicitly anchors this office to him. The hard veto on c0 (explicit_identity_contradiction) is appropriate since 司空 here refers to 張華, not to a different person.

The mention 張華 in annotation sfh1-ev-01-dexing-012-liu-annotation-006 ('王隱晉書曰張華字茂先范陽人也累遷司空') refers to the historical figure 張華. The annotation explicitly provides his courtesy name 茂先, his origin 范陽, and his office 司空. The candidate evidence from people.json provides the canonical name 張華. This is the same well-known Jin dynasty figure 張華 referenced in the main text. The annotation explicitly identifies this person.

The context of the stepmother (後母) directly ties to the main text where 王祥事後母朱夫人甚謹.

The candidate evidence from people.json confirms 王祥 as a canonical person.

The reference semantics itself fails closed, indicating the system could not confirm this resolution. Without specific evidence tying this mention to 王戎, the resolution should be rejected or flagged for review.
